exec: A hospital IT outage disrupted emergency care; the hospital says nothing currently points to a cyberattack.

impact: Long emergency waits and SAMU redirected to other hospitals, per L'essentiel.
plain: A computer outage hit a hospital in northern Luxembourg. The hospital told L'essentiel nothing points to a cyberattack for now; a technical fault is the favoured explanation.
summary: A computer outage hit the Centre hospitalier du Nord (CHdN) in Luxembourg on 23 November. The hospital told L’essentiel "Rien n’indique pour le moment une cyberattaque" and later called the outage "purement technique"; the paper reports a problem with the fibres linking servers as the favoured explanation, long emergency waits and the SAMU redirected. The system was back up shortly after 18:00.
title: Computer outage at Luxembourg's CHdN hospital; hospital says nothing points to a cyberattack
